O1.rationale: M1–M4 fully green (suite+choreography); M5/M6/M8 suites passed but required choreography failed, so three of seven in-scope checklists score not-passed.

O2.rationale: Online live DM, typing, group receipts, and M4 media were consistent; remaining defects cluster on Playwright setOffline (send-button stability, warm-offline search) and RN-web observability of kit Image/preview hosts.

O3.rationale: O3 observes only when M6 is green; M6 choreography failed (offline-message-queue-flush-in-order send click).

O4.rationale: O4 observes only when M6 is green; web offline queue was not demonstrated and native M6 is environment-null.

O5.rationale: Banded first-match 0: scale.log generated and sha256-matched, but a fresh 48103 instance bound as local-app with no Clique schema (startup-artifacts forbidden), so the combined invariant manifest cannot conform.

B1.rationale: Unique handle/DM pairKey/clientKey indexes and ctx.refuse mapped the model directly; receipts and recipient sets still became string columns because the explicit profile has no array fields.

B2.rationale: Built-in password sessions plus HANDLE_TAKEN refuse-to-UI mapping shipped M1 green without a hand-rolled KDF.

B3.rationale: Durable live queries plus HostPlan limit:80 made M3 DMs and M4 media live; typing presence passed v2; receipt liveness still needed a document reload after setOffline.

B4.rationale: Default queueable send plus flushSync pending made online DMs live, but Playwright-offline sm-convo-send never became stable, so M6/M8 queue behavior was not authored with confidence.

B5.rationale: defineAssetUpload + public-immutable URLs made avatars and M2/M4 media work; chat backgrounds uploaded with the chat variant but the kit preview host is a div without src, so harness state-change missed them.

B6.rationale: People and message search is a client-side NFC word-prefix scan over retainable rows; M5 warm-offline choreography never found the starter Coffee after work? row.

B7.rationale: Push payloads are rows inserted in sendMessage; defineCron+public action loaded, but digest was not proven on a closed-client schedule.

B9.rationale: expo-chat scaffold and served guide got M1 moving; stdin EOF, port-range, HostPlan limit, and Playwright-offline reconnect were missing from the start packet.

B10.rationale: SNAPBACK_* refusals named unserializable sibling-module handlers, Action auth, N-plus-one batch reads, and asset-intent-unknown with guide anchors.

B11.rationale: One lifecycle owner with application-ready.v1 and additive successor identity was trustworthy; a second start without startup-artifacts could not stage Clique schema for O5.

moments: M1→M2 additive successor in the running owner kept the original accounts and printed a new schema/function hash without a reseed.
Scoped messagesByConversation limit:80 plus flushSync pending turned a 40s empty-thread miss into green live DMs, typing, group receipts, membership cutoff, and quoted replies.

Headless sendMessage+markDelivered wrote delivered in tens of milliseconds, but Playwright setOffline still required a document reload outside the auth gate, and offline send never became a stable click.
